map.24 小时模式：日交通量 = Σ各小时流量；高峰小时流量 = 最大值；小时平均: 24-hour mode: daily volume = Σ hourly flows; peak hour volume = the maximum value; hourly average = daily total ÷ number of hours; peak share = peak hour ÷ daily total ×100%; the AADT estimate takes the daily total. Peak hour mode: peak hour total = Q1+Q2+Q3+Q4; PHF = peak hour total ÷ (4 × max quarter-hourly flow); equivalent hourly flow rate = max quarter-hourly flow × 4. Uniformity: PHF≥0.9 uniform, ≥0.8 fairly uniform, ≥0.7 noticeable fluctuation, <0.7 severe fluctuation.
